payload.credit_html:
Gilmore, C. (1925). "A nearly complete articulated skeleton of Camarasaurus, a saurischian dinosaur from the Dinosaur National Monument". Memoirs of the Carnegie Museum. 10: 347–384. doi:10.5962/p.217807.

https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/part/217807
payload.description_html:
Original image caption:

" Restoration of skeleton of Carnarasaurus lentus (Marsh).

This restoration is based on the nearly complete skeleton shown in plates XIII and XIV. It is the first restoration of a sauropod dinosaur to be made entirely on the evidence of a single individual. Restoration by Mr. Sidney Prentice under the direction of the author. About one-tenth natural size.

"
